config.title: Efficient Monte Carlo Pricing of Asian Options with Control Variates

timing.wall_seconds: Mean per-estimate pricing time, including the independent CV pilot and all main paths; excludes subprocess startup, warmup, I/O and summary calculations.
timing.internal_repeats: Same seed repeated until at least min_seconds cumulative pricing time; this improves timing only and does not increase N.
timing.process_seconds: Fresh worker lifetime including startup, warmup and internal timing repetitions.
timing.memory: Fresh-process ru_maxrss converted to MiB; includes interpreter and warmup, not a baseline-subtracted allocation.

statistics.independent_units: One estimate per unique seed; timing repeat is not a new independent sample.
statistics.variance_reduction_vs_b: Median B sample variance / method sample variance, paired by identical model,N,seed,repeat; one repeat per seed for statistical ratios.
statistics.time_se2_ratio_vs_b: Median method(time*SE^2) / B(time*SE^2), paired by model,N,seed,repeat; lower is better.
statistics.price_ci_figure: Representative seed 2026, first timing repeat; its individual 95% CI is not attached to the mean of ten seeds.
